subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking from New York to London on August 15th. Your flight details are as follows: Flight Number: ABC123, Departure Time: 10:00 AM, Arrival Time: 2:00 PM. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Safe travels, The Airline Team
